title: Unit Event — No seek No find — Episode5 Dissonant Feelings

meta.Event Outline: Leo/need has decided to perform at a new live house to take the next step in their journey. Saki writes a new song to play at the show, but it doesn't seem to resonate with the audience at all...

rows.Line: That night
Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: “It's okay because we're together now”...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: “Things might seem hard now, but things will be much better since you have a fun future ahead of you”... Yeah, this is what I was looking for...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's so much better than what I had yesterday! Alright...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This still isn't what I was hoping for... Why is that...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Even after I worked in how lonely I felt back then and how I'm trying to say, “It's gonna be okay,” to my old self...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What should I do? At this rate...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Maybe I just don't have what it takes to write a song that resonates with that crowd...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, I can't give up...
I can't stop here!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I have to keep going. I have to keep trying. I have to write a song that really hits home with them...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, one more time...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (This isn't right either...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(I've written so many now...
But it's obvious that no one will think much of them.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I mean, I don't even think they're good...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(They feel so superficial...
Like I'm just tracing over something.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Why is that?
I have a clear picture in my head...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What am I supposed to do...?
bgm_area00001
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Man, milk after practicing really is the best!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I agree. The rolls Saki brought over for us are delicious as well...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, I might try some next time.
She even said that she'd bring something different over.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That reminds me. It's been a while since Saki and the girls did that show. How do you think it went...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I haven't heard anything, so I can't say...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Maybe there's nothing to talk about because it went well? I also wanna hear more about Saki's new song, so maybe we can ask them later about all that.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That sounds good...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Anyway, break time's over!
We gotta keep practicing so we don't get left behind!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: W-Wait, I'm still eating...

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line: Oh, it's you two...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, hey, Saki!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I didn't notice at all.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, sorry... Did I interrupt your meal?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
It's okay...
We're just about finished.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Actually, we were wondering how that show you were talking about went.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, okay...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Is it just me, or do you seem kinda tired, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah...
A lot happened and...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm... I see...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You have a good idea of what you want to do but can't seem to turn it into music...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I don't understand why I can't make my ideas a reality even though I know exactly what I want to do...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, that's a tough one.
I'm not sure what to say either...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Can I ask you a question?
What sort of image do you have in your head right now, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, I'm trying to write a song that tells people who are feeling lonely that things will be okay... I'm also trying to write it in a way that reaches the old me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Which is why I've been thinking a lot about what I felt back then...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What you felt back then...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, I...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You don't have to tell us if you feel uncomfortable. It's not like we're here to interrogate you or anything.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, it's not that I feel uncomfortable...!
It's just... It's not exactly a happy story, you know?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's about when I was in the hospital and felt really lonely because I couldn't see anyone...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: When you were in the hospital...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: If you have such a clear picture in your mind, I figure you'd be able to let your feelings flow forth and write a really good song...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Since we're on the topic, Saki, mind letting us hear your song? Maybe we can pick up some clues from it...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, good idea...!
I'll try playing it for you guys.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: S-So, how was it...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Your song definitely seems to cover what you mentioned just now, Saki.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I thought the same...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
But how do I put this...?
We weren't getting the full scope of your feelings.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The full scope...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Your story about when you were in the hospital was full of all these details, but your song seemed to be missing something...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
This is just my guess...
But you might want to open up more about what you felt, maybe?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Like... How you really felt back then?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: How I really felt...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah. I'm wondering if you're not able to really express yourself because you haven't quite found the right answer yet.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: For example, there could be something you're not remembering.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Something I'm not remembering...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm... Am I forgetting something...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I hated getting tested because it always hurt so much, and I felt really jealous when I saw those girls around my age having fun talking...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Wait...
What else happened?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(That's so weird...
More definitely happened...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Did that remind you of anything?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I can't remember exactly...
My memory's kinda cloudy...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But you might be right, Len.
There could be something that I'm not remembering.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Then, you might want to keep digging.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: By doing so, you might be able to figure out a way to write a song that really resonates with the people you were talking about.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You're right.
I'll try giving this some more thought!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I hope you figure it out.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Same!
And thank you too, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'll see you two later!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay, good luck!
